validated_workbench_assets_and_terminal_.en: Validated {0} workbench assets and {1} terminal assets.
validated_workbench_assets_and_terminal_.zh_cn: 已校验 {0} 项工作台资源、{1} 项终端资源。

the_current_account_cannot_write_to_thes.en: The current account cannot write to these installation targets:
the_current_account_cannot_write_to_thes.zh_cn: 当前账户不能写入以下安装目标：

the_workbench_must_update_resources_wind.en: The workbench must update resources/window.html in the Typora installation directory. Protected directories require Windows administrator authorization; moving the backup does not remove this requirement.
the_workbench_must_update_resources_wind.zh_cn: 工作台需要修改Typora安装目录的resources/window.html；受保护的安装目录需要Windows管理员授权。移动备份不能免除该权限。

the_host_entry_is_unchanged_so_this_upda.en: The host entry is unchanged, so this update does not need to write to the installation directory. The restriction affects the configuration, assets, or backup paths listed above; check the selected user directory. Downloading itself does not require administrator privileges.
the_host_entry_is_unchanged_so_this_upda.zh_cn: 宿主入口未变化，本次无须写入安装目录；受限的是上述配置/资源或备份位置，请核对所选用户目录。下载本身不要求管理员权限。

the_administrator_or_already_authorized_.en: The administrator or already authorized process still cannot write. Check the paths' ACLs and security software policies. The installer will not request authorization again or change directory permissions.
the_administrator_or_already_authorized_.zh_cn: 管理员或已授权进程仍无写权限；请检查上述路径的ACL和安全软件策略。安装器不会重复请求授权或修改目录权限。

unattended_installation_has_not_been_aut.en: Unattended installation has not been authorized to display UAC. Retry through the normal interactive entry or pass -allow_elevation to allow Windows authorization. Installation targets were not changed.
unattended_installation_has_not_been_aut.zh_cn: 无人值守安装未授权显示UAC。请用普通交互入口重试，或显式传入-allow_elevation以允许Windows系统授权；安装目标未修改。

windows_administrator_authorization_will.en: Windows administrator authorization will be requested. Canceling stops installation and preserves the current version. The authorized child process continues the same installation transaction and returns when finished.
windows_administrator_authorization_will.zh_cn: 即将请求Windows管理员授权；取消则停止安装，保留原版本。授权子进程沿用同一安装事务，完成后自动返回。

save_your_documents_and_restart_typora_n.en: Save your documents and restart Typora normally to load the new version. Child-process installation logs are under logs/installation in the original user data directory.
save_your_documents_and_restart_typora_n.zh_cn: 保存文档后正常重启Typora加载新版；安装子进程日志位于原用户数据目录的logs/installation。

installation_did_not_complete_restoring_.en: Installation did not complete. Restoring the previous state. Reason:
installation_did_not_complete_restoring_.zh_cn: 安装未完成，正在恢复安装前状态。原因：

this_installation_was_rolled_back_the_ba.en: This installation was rolled back. The backup has been preserved.
this_installation_was_rolled_back_the_ba.zh_cn: 已回滚本次安装，备份已保留。

keep_the_backup_and_logs_for_recovery_ba.en: Keep the backup and logs for recovery. Backup:
keep_the_backup_and_logs_for_recovery_ba.zh_cn: 请保留备份和日志用于恢复。Backup:

old_upgrade_backup_cleanup_did_not_compl.en: Old upgrade backup cleanup did not complete; the installation result is preserved:
old_upgrade_backup_cleanup_did_not_compl.zh_cn: 升级备份回收未完成，安装结果保留：

installation_completed_in_seconds.zh_cn: 安装完成，总用时 {0:N1} 秒。

save_your_documents_and_restart_typora_n.en: Save your documents and restart Typora normally to load this installation.
save_your_documents_and_restart_typora_n.zh_cn: 保存文档后正常重启 Typora，即可加载本次安装。

select_vscode2026_light_or_vscode2026_da.en: Select VSCode2026_Light or VSCode2026_Dark in the Theme menu. Existing CppGithubConsoles_Light/Dark, Night, and preferences are preserved.
select_vscode2026_light_or_vscode2026_da.zh_cn: 在“主题”菜单选择 VSCode2026_Light 或 VSCode2026_Dark；原 CppGithubConsoles_Light/Dark、Night 和已有偏好设置保留。

installation_has_not_written_any_target_.en: Installation has not written any target files; rollback is unnecessary.
installation_has_not_written_any_target_.zh_cn: 安装尚未写入目标文件，无须回滚。

the_old_backup_is_not_a_verified_typorac.en: The old backup is not a verified TyporaCode upgrade. Native or unknown recovery data is preserved.
the_old_backup_is_not_a_verified_typorac.zh_cn: 旧备份不是可确认的TyporaCode升级，保留原生或未知恢复资料。

removed_old_automatic_upgrade_backup.zh_cn: 已回收旧自动升级备份：

the_log_file_cannot_be_saved_progress_wi.en: The log file cannot be saved. Progress will still be displayed in this window.
the_log_file_cannot_be_saved_progress_wi.zh_cn: 无法保存日志文件，本次过程仍会在此窗口显示。

the_log_file_is_no_longer_writable_insta.en: The log file is no longer writable. Installation progress will still be displayed in this window.
the_log_file_is_no_longer_writable_insta.zh_cn: 日志文件无法继续写入，安装过程仍会在此窗口显示。

the_file_is_read_only_check_and_clear_th.zh_cn: 文件为只读，请核对并取消只读属性后重试；不会通过提权绕过：{value_0}

an_installation_target_expected_to_be_a_.en: An installation target expected to be a file is a directory: {value_0}
an_installation_target_expected_to_be_a_.zh_cn: 应为文件的安装目标是目录：{value_0}

cannot_find_the_installation_target_s_pa.en: Cannot find the installation target's parent directory: {value_0}
cannot_find_the_installation_target_s_pa.zh_cn: 找不到安装目标的父目录：{value_0}

installation_write_preflight_failed_file.en: Installation write preflight failed (file locks, read-only attributes, and disk errors do not trigger administrator authorization): {0}; {1}
installation_write_preflight_failed_file.zh_cn: 安装写入预检失败（占用、只读或磁盘错误不会触发管理员授权）：{0}；{1}

typora_install_cancelled_windows_adminis.en: [TYPORA_INSTALL_CANCELLED] Windows administrator authorization was canceled. Installation targets were not changed.
typora_install_cancelled_windows_adminis.zh_cn: [TYPORA_INSTALL_CANCELLED] 已取消Windows管理员授权，安装目标未修改。

no_completion_receipt_was_received_check.en: No completion receipt was received. Check the installation logs in the user data directory.
no_completion_receipt_was_received_check.zh_cn: 未收到完成记录，请检查用户数据目录下的安装日志。

administrator_installation_did_not_compl.en: Administrator installation did not complete (exit code {value_0}): {value_1}
administrator_installation_did_not_compl.zh_cn: 管理员安装未完成（退出码 {value_0}）：{value_1}

checking_the_local_cache_for_node.en: Checking the local cache for Node {value_0} / {value_1}.
checking_the_local_cache_for_node.zh_cn: 检查 Node {value_0} / {value_1} 的本地缓存。

downloading_the_runtime_from_nodejs_org_.en: Downloading the runtime from nodejs.org. The first installation may take a few minutes; keep this window open.
downloading_the_runtime_from_nodejs_org_.zh_cn: 正在从 nodejs.org 下载运行时；首次安装可能需要几分钟，请保持此窗口打开。

download_complete_verifying_sha_256.zh_cn: 下载完成，正在校验 SHA-256。

reusing_the_cache_verified_by_sha_256_no.en: Reusing the cache verified by SHA-256; no download is needed.
reusing_the_cache_verified_by_sha_256_no.zh_cn: 已复用通过 SHA-256 校验的缓存，无须重新下载。

extracting_and_verifying_runtime_files.zh_cn: 正在解压并校验运行时文件。

save_your_documents_and_fully_exit_typor.zh_cn: 请先保存文档并完全退出 Typora 后重试（检测到进程编号：{0}）。本次未关闭进程，也未修改任何文件。
